limitations.description: N = 20 incidents provides limited statistical power. A single misclassification represents a 5% shift in accuracy.
Wilson score 95% confidence interval at N=20 with 90% observed accuracy spans [69.9%, 97.2%].
Limited to 2 rules (CrowdStrike Suspicious Activity and Prisma SASE Suspicious File); does not represent the full FortiSIEM catalog.
Awaiting initial Level 2 human reviews. Zero Level 3/4 corroborated labels exist.
